record.bible_text: <FO><FO>A Song<WH07892> <FI>or<Fi> Psalm<WH04210> for the sons<WH01121> of Korah<WH07141>, to the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764> upon Mahalath<WH04257> Leannoth<WH06031><WTH8763>, Maschil<WH04905><WTH8688> of Heman<WH01968> the Ezrahite<WH0250>.<Fo><Fo> O LORD<WH03068> God<WH0430> of my salvation<WH03444>, I have cried<WH06817><WTH8804> day<WH03117> <FI>and<Fi> night<WH03915> before thee: <RF>for the sons: or, of the sons<Rf> <RF>Maschil...: or, A Psalm of Heman the Ezrahite, giving instruction<Rf>
Let my prayer<WH08605> come<WH0935><WTH8799> before<WH06440> thee: incline<WH05186><WTH8685> thine ear<WH0241> unto my cry<WH07440>;
For my soul<WH05315> is full<WH07646><WTH8804> of troubles<WH07451>: and my life<WH02416> draweth nigh<WH05060><WTH8689> unto the grave<WH07585>.
I am counted<WH02803><WTH8738> with them that go down<WH03381><WTH8802> into the pit<WH0953>: I am as a man<WH01397> <FI>that hath<Fi> no strength<WH0353>:

Free<WH02670> among the dead<WH04191><WTH8801>, like the slain<WH02491> that lie<WH07901><WTH8802> in the grave<WH06913>, whom thou rememberest<WH02142><WTH8804> no more: and they are cut off<WH01504><WTH8738> from thy hand<WH03027>. <RF>from: or, by<Rf>
Thou hast laid<WH07896><WTH8804> me in the lowest<WH08482> pit<WH0953>, in darkness<WH04285>, in the deeps<WH04688>.
Thy wrath<WH02534> lieth hard<WH05564><WTH8804> upon me, and thou hast afflicted<WH06031><WTH8765> <FI>me<Fi> with all thy waves<WH04867>. Selah<WH05542>.

Thou hast put away<WH07368><WH00> mine acquaintance<WH03045><WTH8794> far<WH07368><WTH8689> from me; thou hast made<WH07896><WTH8804> me an abomination<WH08441> unto them: <FI>I am<Fi> shut up<WH03607><WTH8803>, and I cannot come forth<WH03318><WTH8799>.

Mine eye<WH05869> mourneth<WH01669><WTH8804> by reason of affliction<WH06040>: LORD<WH03068>, I have called<WH07121><WTH8804> daily<WH03117> upon thee, I have stretched out<WH07849><WTH8765> my hands<WH03709> unto thee.<CM>
Wilt thou shew<WH06213><WTH8799> wonders<WH06382> to the dead<WH04191><WTH8801>? shall the dead<WH07496> arise<WH06965><WTH8799> <FI>and<Fi> praise<WH03034><WTH8686> thee? Selah<WH05542>.
Shall thy lovingkindness<WH02617> be declared<WH05608><WTH8792> in the grave<WH06913>? <FI>or<Fi> thy faithfulness<WH0530> in destruction<WH011>?
Shall thy wonders<WH06382> be known<WH03045><WTH8735> in the dark<WH02822>? and thy righteousness<WH06666> in the land<WH0776> of forgetfulness<WH05388>?
But unto thee have I cried<WH07768><WTH8765>, O LORD<WH03068>; and in the morning<WH01242> shall my prayer<WH08605> prevent<WH06923><WTH8762> thee.
LORD<WH03068>, why castest thou off<WH02186><WTH8799> my soul<WH05315>? <FI>why<Fi> hidest<WH05641><WTH8686> thou thy face<WH06440> from me?
I <FI>am<Fi> afflicted<WH06041> and ready to die<WH01478><WTH8802> from <FI>my<Fi> youth<WH05290> up: <FI>while<Fi> I suffer<WH05375><WTH8804> thy terrors<WH0367> I am distracted<WH06323><WTH8799>.
Thy fierce wrath<WH02740> goeth over<WH05674><WTH8804> me; thy terrors<WH01161> have cut me off<WH06789><WTH8768>.
They came round about<WH05437><WTH8804> me daily<WH03117> like water<WH04325>; they compassed<WH05362><WTH8689> me about together<WH03162>. <RF>daily: or, all the day<Rf>
Lover<WH0157><WTH8802> and friend<WH07453> hast thou put far<WH07368><WTH8689> from me, <FI>and<Fi> mine acquaintance<WH03045><WTH8794> into darkness<WH04285>.<CM>
